lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mg14Fe2 (reduced formula LiMg7Fe) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Fe, Li, and Mg centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg–Mg distances span 3.0419–3.4173 Å, while Fe–Mg and Li–Mg contacts range from about 2.58 to 3.41 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts among 12-vertex Mg polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
